etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Middle French elegie, from Latin elegīa, itself a borrowing from Ancient Greek ἐλεγείᾱ (elegeíā), ellipsis of ἐλεγείᾱ ᾠδή (elegeíā ōidḗ, “an elegiac song”).
senses: A mournful or plaintive poem; a funeral song; a poem of lamentation. [from early 16th c.]
